consequence.statement: New capability: PolicyException resources now feed exclusions into generated ValidatingAdmissionPolicies; the evidence states no failure or required operator action.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds support for PolicyException resources to populate matchConstraints.excludeResourceRules of ValidatingAdmissionPolicies auto-generated from policies using validate.cel.
